case_results.name: Live JavaScript Variance Calculation Defect
case_results.reproducible_command: cd 'C:\Users\SURYA NARAYAN C K\Downloads\FixForge-main\FixForge-main\.benchmark_workspaces\live-8bf0ab6b\live_js_stats' && node --test tests/stats.test.mjs tests/regression.test.mjs

root_cause.summary: calculateVariance incorrectly divides by numbers.length - 2 instead of numbers.length for population variance, causing an assertion failure.
root_cause.root_cause: The calculateVariance function in stats.mjs divides the sum of squared differences by (numbers.length - 2) instead of numbers.length, resulting in a larger actual value (5.333333333333333) than the expected population variance (4).
root_cause.observed: AssertionError: Expected values to be strictly equal: actual 5.333333333333333, expected 4.
root_cause.hypothesis: The division denominator in calculateVariance is incorrectly set to numbers.length - 2 instead of numbers.length, which leads to an overestimation of the population variance.

evidence.reason: The return statement divides sumSquaredDiffs by (numbers.length - 2).

hypotheses.root_cause_statement: calculateVariance divides by numbers.length - 2 instead of numbers.length when calculating population variance.
hypotheses.causal_explanation: Dividing by length - 2 rather than length reduces the denominator incorrectly, producing a higher variance than expected.
hypotheses.proposed_repair_strategy: Change numbers.length - 2 to numbers.length on line 13 in stats.mjs.
